sources.ref: NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2, B.E./B.Tech question paper 'B Tech 2nd Apr 2026 Shift 1' (English)
NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2 final answer key of B.E./B.Tech on which result compiled, Exam Date 02.04.2026, Shift First (page 1)

notes: Previous-year questions from NTA's JEE (Main) 2026 paper of 2 April 2026, Shift 1 (B.E./B.Tech), ingested with pyq-ingest. Stems, options, statements and list items keep NTA's English wording exactly; NTA published this paper in English only, so the Hindi is our translation (hi_source: translation) and must be reviewed as such. Answers are NTA's final key (result-compiled, Session 2); our own solutions reach the same answer for every question in this file. Question ids 9001 and up mark ingested PYQs.

stem.en: For reaction $A \to P$, rate constant $k=1.5\times10^3\ \mathrm{s^{-1}}$ at $27\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. If activation energy for the above reaction is $60\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$, then the temperature (in $^\circ\mathrm{C}$) at which rate constant, $k=4.5\times10^3\ \mathrm{s^{-1}}$ is ______. (Nearest integer) Given : $\log2=0.30$, $\log3=0.48$, $R=8.3\ \mathrm{J\,K^{-1}\,mol^{-1}}$, $\ln10=2.3$
stem.hi: अभिक्रिया $A \to P$ के लिए दर स्थिरांक $k=1.5\times10^3\ \mathrm{s^{-1}}$ है, ताप $27\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ पर। यदि उपर्युक्त अभिक्रिया की सक्रियण ऊर्जा $60\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$ है, तो वह ताप ($^\circ\mathrm{C}$ में) जिस पर दर स्थिरांक $k=4.5\times10^3\ \mathrm{s^{-1}}$ हो, ______ है। (निकटतम पूर्णांक) दिया है : $\log2=0.30$, $\log3=0.48$, $R=8.3\ \mathrm{J\,K^{-1}\,mol^{-1}}$, $\ln10=2.3$

feynman.en: The rate constant triples, so use the two-temperature Arrhenius form: $\log\frac{k_2}{k_1}=\frac{E_a}{2.3R}\left(\frac1{T_1}-\frac1{T_2}\right)$.
feynman.hi: दर स्थिरांक तीन गुना होता है, अतः दो-ताप वाला आरेनियस रूप लीजिए: $\log\frac{k_2}{k_1}=\frac{E_a}{2.3R}\left(\frac1{T_1}-\frac1{T_2}\right)$।
